# Sixth review of SEEN-108, attempt 9, from the seen-reviewer subagent

Spawned fresh on opus with the task text of triage record 98, and told which six
test modules no earlier review had read in their current state. Verdict
`return`, three findings, none high. It verified rather than took on trust:
`agents.routed` and `agents.drift` on this checkout, both SKILL copies
byte-identical, `triage.procedure_paths` excluding the implementer copies so the
per-slice regeneration cannot move the reviewed fingerprint, and `kpi.measure`
over this journal reproducing the four slice costs the outcome quotes. It
compared every accepted tdd advance's failure reason against its cited check and
confirmed the three the journal already corrects. It judged `slice_files` a
plan-accuracy gap for the fifth time.

- **F1, medium, harness/templates/tdd.json:5.** The template ships a literal
  `"position": 1` where every other field ships instructive prose, so a session
  drafting a rework round inherits the one value that is wrong for most rounds
  after the first. An integer passes `require_template_fields`, which reads only
  top-level keys, and `reject_placeholders`, which compares strings. With shadow
  false, slice 3's rework declaring its own routed model is then refused against
  slice 1's route, which is the mistake this ticket made at record 82. Note 83
  asked the next ticket touching this file to put the reading in its own prose;
  attempt 9 touched it one attempt later, added the value without the prose, and
  turned the remedy note 83 names, leaving the field out, into one the gate now
  refuses.
- **F2, medium, harness/report.py:184.** The row does not reconcile: Points is
  every point the model carried, Cost covers only the slices that could be
  priced, and Cost per point divides by the priced points. On this ticket's own
  figures the row reads `| opus | 3 | 5 | 69204 | 519 | 173.0 |`, and a reader
  computing 519 over 5 gets 103.8. `priced_points` reaches the JSON payload and
  is dropped from the markdown, and the footnote is what tells the reader this
  row is what routing is judged on.
- **F3, low, harness/tests/test_context_budget.py:270 and test_triage.py:1582.**
  Five test classes are defined after the module's `unittest.main()` guard, so
  running either file directly reports OK having collected none of them. A
  developer iterating on `report.render_cost` that way reintroduces the fifth
  review's F1, the TypeError that stopped the sprint report being written, and
  sees a green run. Every other module in the directory keeps the guard last.
